business_summary: Smart-Core Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, distributes integrated circuits and other electronic components in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, Singapore, Japan, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Authorised Distribution and Mixed Distribution. The company offers SoC (System on Chip) chips; memory chips and modules comprising DRAM, NOR Flash, NAND Flash, MCP, KGD wafers, and enterprise-grade eSSDs; and core transmitter- and receiver-end chips and components for data communication optical modules. Its products are used in various applications, such as TV products, smart terminals, memory products, optoelectronic displays, communication, security monitoring, Internet of Things (IoT), optical communication, and others. The company also provides optical communication chips; engineering support; and chip supply chain assurance, customized technical solutions, and full-lifecycle technical support services. In addition, it operates an e-commerce platform. The company serves consumer electronic product manufacturing companies, original design manufacturers, and original equipment manufacturers in the electronic product industry. The company was formerly known as Smart-Core Cloud Group Limited and changed its name to Smart-Core Holdings Limited in August 2016. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong. Smart-Core Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Smart IC Limited.
